# Docket SEO

> Docket SEO is a Mac app that audits any website on your own Mac: 99 checks across 13
> areas, then one ranked plan of what to fix, in order, with the markup to paste and a
> client-ready PDF report. It costs $349, paid once; there is no subscription.

The crawl and the report stay on the Mac, and there is no account and no telemetry.
Five optional checks are on by default and reach outside it: Google PageSpeed Insights
is sent the addresses of the homepage and top pages; Google's public autocomplete is
sent the site's topic words, typed by the user or read off its titles, headings and
descriptions; DNS is asked about the mail domains the site publishes; the audited
server is asked what it tells AI crawlers; and docketseo.app serves a knowledge file.
Offline mode turns all five off. Checking links to other sites, and rendering a few
pages as a browser would, also reach the sites and services those pages link to or
load. The licence key is checked with the payment provider when it is activated and
about once a day after that, and the app asks docketseo.app whether an update exists.

Docket is written by Matt Kerr and sold by Kerr & Company LLC, of Grand Rapids,
Michigan, United States.

## What it checks

- 99 checks across 13 areas: AI search visibility, Brand consistency, Content quality,
  Conversion & landing pages, Crawlability & indexing, Links, Local business SEO,
  Tracking & campaign readiness, On-page SEO, Speed & Core Web Vitals, Structured
  data, Security & trust and Social & sharing.
- Every finding is ranked by impact against the effort of fixing it, and carries its
  evidence: the page it is on, the exact value found there, and the fix.
- AI search visibility: each AI crawler is checked separately (OAI-SearchBot for
  ChatGPT Search, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot and Google-Extended) and kept apart
  from training crawlers such as GPTBot. Docket also requests pages as each crawler
  and reports when a server refuses one that robots.txt permits.
- A command-line interface ships inside the app. `docket audit` exits non-zero on a
  critical issue, so CI can fail a build before it ships.
- [All 99 checks, by area](https://docketseo.app/learn/what-docket-checks/): the complete list, generated from the shipped build so it cannot drift from the product
- [How Docket decides what to fix first](https://docketseo.app/learn/priority-model/): severity, impact, reach and effort, and the formula that combines them

## Sample report

- [Sample report (PDF)](https://docketseo.app/assets/docket-sample-report.pdf): a full sample of the client-ready PDF Docket writes: score, scorecard, ranked plan, paste-ready markup, and a page on what was and was not measured

## Requirements

- An Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 12 or later. There is no Windows or Intel build
  of the app.
- The Mac app is a 21.9 MB download, signed with a Developer ID and notarised by
  Apple.
- A command-line build for Linux x86_64 is on the download page.

## Price and licence

- $349, paid once, in US dollars. Not a subscription: there is no renewal date and
  nothing to cancel.
- Founding price $174.50 once, first 25 buyers: at checkout, click "Have a discount
  code?" and enter FOUNDINGDOCKET. Then $349.
- Or four payments of $87.25 with Klarna or Afterpay, two weeks apart.
- There is no free trial; the refund window is the trial.
- The licence key arrives by email with the receipt and is pasted into the app once.
  One licence covers up to 3 Macs at a time: activating Docket on a Mac uses one, and
  deactivating one moves the licence to another machine.
- The licence belongs to the person or company that paid. It covers any number of
  websites, including clients' sites, and the work can be billed to those clients. The
  application itself may not be resold, sublicensed or redistributed.

## Refunds

- Thirty days from the date of purchase, no conditions and no questions asked. The
  full purchase price goes back to the payment method it came from.
- To ask, write to support@docketseo.app or reply to the receipt the payment processor
  sends.
- A refund revokes the licence key, and the copy stops running audits within about a
  day.

## What it does not do

- No per-page backlinks or anchor text, and no monthly search volumes.
- Copy-quality checks are English-only; the technical checks work in any language.
- Not built, on purpose: rank tracking, a cloud version, team accounts, server-side
  scheduling, and white-label or uptime monitoring.
- Scheduled re-audits run only while Docket is open: the schedule is a thread inside
  the app, so quitting it stops the clock.

- [Homepage](https://docketseo.app/): what Docket checks, how it ranks what it finds, and the price
- [Download Docket for Mac](https://docketseo.app/download/): the current release, the requirements, the price, and the command line
- [The Docket Index](https://docketseo.app/index/): who is blocking AI search crawlers, measured with Docket's own parser; method and dataset included
- [The AI rules in robots.txt that do nothing](https://docketseo.app/index/ai-directives/): which AI crawler rules in robots.txt name a token no crawler uses
- [Learn](https://docketseo.app/learn/): plain explanations of what an SEO audit covers, how AI search visibility works, and what Docket checks
- [Fix guides](https://docketseo.app/how-to/): the specific problems Docket reports, what each one costs you, and the change to make
- [How Docket compares](https://docketseo.app/vs/): comparisons with Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, Ahrefs, Semrush and others, each naming at least one thing the other tool does better
- [Docket for your situation](https://docketseo.app/for/): SEO agencies, developers, online shops, local businesses and SaaS companies
- [Best tools, by job](https://docketseo.app/best/): which SEO tool fits which job, with every claim read from the product's own documentation
- [AI search visibility](https://docketseo.app/learn/ai-search-visibility/): whether a model can reach, read and quote a site: crawler access, server-side rendering and entity clarity
- [About Docket](https://docketseo.app/about/): who builds it and what it cannot do
- [Contact](https://docketseo.app/contact/): support@docketseo.app for a licence or a refund; the GitHub issue tracker for bugs and wrong findings
- [The Docket crawler](https://docketseo.app/bot/): what Docket's audit crawler requests and the robots.txt rule that asks it to stay out
